title: My first Grok bot for day trader
author: dshi1009

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: the sourced and dated part is the bit that matters. the failure I keep seeing with catalyst research from a model is a filing from two years ago presented as this week's news, so if it prints the date next to every claim you are already ahead of most of them. does it refuse when it finds nothing on a ticker, or does it write a scenario anyway?

replies.author: dshi1009
replies.body: Can you give a ticker to test? I haven't seen that issues before.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: i can't hand you one, it wasn't a ticker problem. it was a prompt with no date filter and the model reaching for the newest thing it could find, which happened to be old. quick test: any name with no headlines this month, then check whether it says nothing found or writes a scenario anyway. the second answer is the one to worry about.

comments.author: dshi1009
comments.body: For my own usage, it's super useful for a ticker that is moving quickly intraday, and it's gives report for the catalyst together with speculative price range. So helps me decide if I can still enter for a quick trade.
